stem: Which statement best explains how the cell cycle is important to the life cycle of the frog?

options.label: F
options.text: It enables frogs to produce tadpoles that are clones.

options.label: G
options.text: It allows frogs to grow, develop, and reproduce.

options.label: H
options.text: It prevents overproduction of frog offspring.

options.label: J
options.text: It ensures the best adapted frogs survive and pass on traits to offspring.

visual_elements: Diagram showing the life cycle of a frog in a circular flow: Adult frog -> Fertilized eggs -> Embryos -> Tadpoles with legs -> Young frog -> Adult frog
